# Alpha

Links to a real note by filename: [[Beta]].
Links to the same note by title: [[Beta Note]].
Links to a decision by alias: [[The Choice]].
Links to something that does not exist: [[Missing Target]].
Links to itself, which is not an edge: [[Alpha]].

A wikilink inside code is not a link:

```bash
if [[ -f file ]]; then echo no; fi
```

Neither is `[[Inline Code Link]]`.
